name: Vincenzo Ferlaino
bioAdditions: Vincenzo was baptized on 4 October 1781, son of Bruno Ferlaino and Francesca Moraca (S1). This makes him the younger brother of Nicola Maria Ferlaino, Leopoldo's grandfather, a link the site does not yet have (it shows no parents for Vincenzo). He married Maria Colosimo, daughter of Andrea, on 17 March 1809 (S2). He died on 10 September 1847, a widower (S3, S4).
funFacts: Vincenzo's parents Bruno Ferlaino and Francesca Moraca are already in John's tree as Nicola Maria's parents, so they are John's ancestors twice over.

relationships.evidence: Baptism, marriage and death name father Bruno Ferlaino
